changelog:
Initial release of Devicebase CLI — a cross-platform tool for remote mobile device control.

- Supports Android, HarmonyOS, and iOS devices via HTTP API.
- Provides commands for tap, swipe, text input, app launching, screenshots, and UI inspection.
- Includes device listing and filtering capabilities.
- Requires DEVICEBASE_API_KEY for authentication.
- Offers detailed usage instructions, environment setup, and common workflows.
summary: Devicebase CLI — cross-platform Go CLI for remote Android, HarmonyOS, and iOS device control via HTTP API. Supports tap, swipe, text input, app launching, screenshots, UI hierarchy inspection, and more.
